claims.reason: The probe shows that sys.tables can be queried and that name is nvarchar(128) on one Fabric item.
claims.unproven: That catalog reads behave the same on the endpoint and the Warehouse, and that sys.tables lists the exposed Lakehouse Delta tables.

claims.reason: CREATE VIEW compiles, but a compile check cannot tell which item it targets or whether the create would succeed there.
claims.unproven: That CREATE VIEW actually succeeds on the read-only endpoint, and that views are the normal way to add logic.

claims.reason: The inline TVF compiles, but compiling does not show that creation succeeds on the endpoint.
claims.unproven: That the function can actually be created when run on the read-only endpoint.

claims.reason: A read-only procedure compiles, but nothing shows run-time creation on the endpoint, and no writing body was tested.
claims.unproven: Creation on the endpoint at run time, and the restriction that the body may only read data or use temp tables.

claims.reason: CREATE TABLE compiled with an empty result set, which supports the compile-time part of the claim.
claims.unproven: That the read-only restriction is enforced when the statement runs.

claims.reason: CTAS compiled with no result columns, and the remaining sentence is only a caveat about what compiling can show.
SELECT INTO compiled with no result columns, and the remaining sentence is only a caveat about what compiling can show.
The engine returned error 11525, and its message states the single-statement temp-table limitation of metadata discovery.
Error 24581 states that global temporary tables are not supported, which directly covers the claim.
A non-existent item name fails with error 208 as an invalid object, as the second sentence says.
claims.unproven: That three-part names resolve only against Warehouses and Lakehouse endpoints in the same workspace.

claims.reason: Error 7202 reports that a server was not found in sys.servers and even suggests sp_addlinkedserver, rather than saying four-part names are unsupported.
claims.unproven: That four-part names or linked servers do not exist in Fabric.

claims.reason: Error 15871 names SCOPE_IDENTITY as not supported.
DB_NAME() compiles and returns nvarchar(128) on one Fabric item.
claims.unproven: That it works on both the endpoint and the Warehouse, and that the value it returns is the item name.
